 New sub-$20,000 PHEV SUV opens for preorders with 320 km EV range, optional LiDAR
 ⓘ Dongfeng Nissan - edited The Nissan NX7 is now live for preorders; the launch date is set for November 27. Dongfeng Nissan has opened NX7 pre-sales in China from 129,900 yuan. The plug-in hybrid SUV uses a 40.9 kWh CATL battery rated for 320 km CLTC, though its MIIT filing lists 225 km WLTC. LiDAR is limited to the top trim. Launch is set for November 27. Anubhav Sharma , Published 11/16/2026 E-Mobility Launch 
 4 Reviews     ← exclude selected types     ← exclude selected tags 
 Dongfeng Nissan has opened pre-sales for the NX7 in China. The plug-in hybrid SUV previously made its debu t at Nissan’s brand event in Zhuhai on November 13. The full market launch, however, is set for the Guangzhou Auto Show on November 27. Pre-sale pricing starts at 129,900 yuan (around US$19,470) for the 320 Pro. It then runs through the 320 Max at 139,900 yuan and the 320 Ultra LiDAR Edition at 149,900 yuan. 
 The "320" in each trim name refers to the electric range. All three variants use the same 40.9 kWh CATL lithium iron phosphate battery rated for 320 km on the CLTC cycle. That is the generous Chinese figure, though. The NX7’s regulatory filing with the MIIT lists 220 km and 225 km under WLTC (depending on configuration). Dongfeng Nissan quotes a combined CLTC range of 1,666 km too. 
 Power comes from a 1.5-liter naturally aspirated engine rated at 73 kW, and also a 170 kW drive motor. The NX7 measures 4,785 mm long and comes on a 2,815 mm wheelbase. That puts it below the larger NX8 in the N-series lineup. Boot space is 783 liters, and it increases to 1,878 liters with the rear seats folded.
 ⓘ Dongfeng Nissan - machine translated ⓘ Dongfeng Nissan - machine translated 
 The trims are divided mostly on the basis of comfort and driver assistance. The 320 Pro gets a 17.3-inch 3K central display and Level 2 driver assistance. The 320 Max adds the Zero-Pressure Cloud Blanket 2.0 seats with heating and ventilation on four seats, alongside a 6.33-liter fridge. Only the 320 Ultra gets the roof-mounted LiDAR. That one also runs Momenta’s R7 system for urban navigate on autopilot and adds a 55-inch AR head-up display. 
 Preorder customers can put down a 999 yuan deposit, which counts as 3,000 yuan off the purchase price. Final pricing will come at launch. As of writing, Nissan has not confirmed whether the NX7 will be sold outside China.
